summary: Harmonic is a Big-4-audited (Ernst & Young) communication-equipment vendor showing classic forensic patterns of customer-concentration-driven revenue inflection that the FY2023 10-K (filed Feb 16, 2024) did not honestly bridge to forward expectations. Headline FY23 'profitability' (net income $84M) masked a Video-segment collapse and an over-reliance on Comcast (44% of revenue, peaking at 47% in Q1 2023). The 10-K presented Broadband as a growth engine driven by a 'large Tier 1 customer' ramp — six weeks later the Q1 2024 10-Q showed BOTH segments down (Broadband -21%, Video -25%) and Comcast share collapsing to 29%. Management took a $115M secured term/revolver draw in April 2024 to fund the convert maturity (converting fixed-2% unsecured to floating ~7% secured debt + 4.6M shares of dilution), and within 75 days of the 10-K filing announced $17M restructuring + $6M lease impairment while simultaneously executing $21.7M of buybacks. The forensic profile is moderate-to-severe disclosure underdelivery: no fraud, no going-concern, no material weakness, but the 10-K's growth/liquidity framing was incompatible with the Q1 execution that management had visibility into when filing.
